business_summary: QuakeSafe Technologies Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells anti-seismic products and shock absorber products in China. The company offers lead rubber, linear natural rubber, elastic sliding, friction pendulum, high damping rubber, correctable rubber, pre correction, and liftable rubber bearings; viscous fluid damper and wall, buckling restrained brace and wall, friction and viscoelastic damper, electromagnetic eddy current damper, rotary friction damper, share and bending type metallic damper, and zero clearance viscous damper; and dual control friction pendulum system, damping spring vibration isolation system, nuclear grade large hydraulic damper, thick laminated composite and rubber bearing, tuned mass damper, eddy current tuned mass damper, polyurethane vibration damping pad, disc spring damping and vibration, and dual control disc spring bearing. It also offers comprehensive solution, flexible connection, and flexible connection module type A and B; type A, B, and C lateral and bidirectional seismic bracing, U and O shaped pipe clamps, single and double combined C-channel steel, seismic resistant connectors, and system components; and anti-wind device type 1 and 2, anti-tension device, cover plate, and staircase rubber bearing. The company was formerly known as Yunnan QuakeSafe Seismic Isolation Technologies Co., Ltd. and changed its name to QuakeSafe Technologies Co., Ltd. in June 2019. QuakeSafe Technologies Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Kunming, China.
